R2_sample1_stage_attribution.conclusion: Observed automatic writes really retarget from the earlier sampler to a distinct later sampler. This is not merely an oracle-label difference. However, the original pre-engine oracle required manual selection of either stage, so the historical automatic earlier-stage write was not an approved automatic contract either. Both versions fail the unchanged manual oracle; the current three automatic writes have no warning. Preserve both the fixed-request failure and the manual-oracle failure for independent review, without treating this as a safe boundary or editing truth.
